review_candidates.title: Human Resources Manager
review_candidates.description: About Java Fire Protection Java Fire Protection is the leading partner for fire safety services and consultancy. We are a family business, in operation since 1957, with four business lines: Fire Extinguishers, Systems & Alarms, Technical Solutions and Consultancy. We are the only company with NFPA-certified fire protection specialists on its team, which makes us the partner of choice for leading institutions in Lebanon and the region. We are based in Lebanon, operate across the MENA region, and have an affiliate in Dubai. We are looking for our next HR Manager to lead our People & Learning department. The Role As HR Manager, you will work directly with the CEO and the CEO Office — a team of consultants from MBB and other tier-one consulting firms — to reinforce the People & Learning department. The objective is to strengthen performance management and talent development, and to refine roles and responsibilities across the organisation. The role is particularly interesting because you will be part of the design and set-up phase before you fully run the department. This role is an opportunity to build something from the start, and to learn from working closely with the CEO and top-tier consultants. Responsibilities BUILDING THE FUNCTION — alongside the CEO Office Contribute to the design and roll-out of the performance management system, including evaluation criteria, performance metrics, review calendar and calibration rules. Run the recruitment plan, including the creation of standardised job profiles, structured interview guides, selection criteria and a clear hiring workflow. Formalise roles, responsibilities and reporting lines across every department, and consolidate them into a clear organisational structure. Digitise HR records and workflows: move personnel files, leave and attendance tracking, and appraisals off paper and onto digital systems. Act as a point of contact for the CEO Office and for the consultants leading improvement initiatives linked to people, talent and learning development. RUNNING HR — ongoing Lead recruitment end to end: define job profiles, source candidates, conduct first-round interviews, present shortlists, and manage the process from offer through to onboarding. Own and run the full appraisal cycle, including tracking of individual and collective performance metrics, mid-year and year-end evaluations, and feedback sharing. Own training and people development: assess skill gaps with department heads, define the annual training plan, and select and schedule programmes. Oversee HR administration: payroll, social security declarations, employment contracts, personnel files and compliance with Lebanese labour law. Track attendance, leave and absence across departments, and maintain visibility on coverage. Report monthly on HR performance — time to fill, review and training completion, turnover, attendance accuracy — and act on what the numbers show. Act as the reference point for managers and employees on people matters, from day-to-day questions through to disciplinary and exit processes. Requirements Degree in business management, psychology, human sciences or a related field. Minimum 5 years of HR experience, ideally in a B2B environment. Proven experience designing or improving HR processes and governance systems. The ideal candidate has designed and run an appraisal programme in a B2B services environment. Solid knowledge of Lebanese labour law, social security and payroll practice. Good command of HR tools and modern evaluation methods; experience with an HRIS is an advantage. Proven experience dealing with stakeholders of diverse backgrounds and seniority. A high standard of confidentiality and professionalism in handling employee information. Fluent Arabic and English, French an advantage, with strong written communication — a significant part of this role is formalising what has never been written down. A reliable communicator. In a people role, words carry weight: you are precise about what you say, you follow through on it, and you can deliver a clear message at any level, from the shop floor to the CEO and the board. Proven ability to work autonomously and take initiative in an evolving, fast-paced environment. The Ideal Candidate Beyond the requirements above, the person we are looking for: Is hungry to learn and looking for a role that will stretch them. Is a doer and a builder, comfortable making things happen without a large structure behind them. Is curious, and takes an interest in parts of the business beyond HR. Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction. Speaks their mind, including when they disagree. Most importantly, has a high degree of empathy and can connect with stakeholders from different backgrounds and seniorities. What We Offer Direct exposure to the CEO and the CEO Office. The experience of building and leading a modern HR function, with a scope that is expected to expand as the company grows. Competitive fixed salary with a performance-linked variable component. A learning opportunity through direct engagement with the CEO Office, and hands-on work with tier-one consultants. How To Apply Send your CV and a brief cover note to serge@jfp-me.com with "HR Manager" in the subject line. Applications are reviewed by the CEO Office.

review_candidates.description: iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies. Our #ilogos_team unites professionals that love, live and breathe games we dare say. This is a place where you’ll find freedom of action and where bureaucracy and micromanagement are unheard of. Now we are growing rapidly and looking for professionals to join the team. Make your personal contribution to the games millions of people are playing; Develop yourself professionally in an atmosphere of trust and support; Work remotely from anywhere in the world on your own schedule; Get your support from teammates and the company. We are looking for a proactive Financial Manager to own and continuously improve our financial management processes. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with hands-on execution, taking responsibility for budgeting, reporting, financial control, and providing management with timely, accurate insights to support business growth. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience in financial management, FP&A, Finance Manager, or a similar role. Proven track record of managing a company's finance function, including budgeting, financial planning, controlling, and reporting. Experience working directly with executive leadership and reporting financial performance to the management board. Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheets, cash flow, and working capital management. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and proactively in a dynamic business environment. What The Role Is About Own the company's budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting processes. Prepare, manage, and present P&L, balance sheet, and financial performance reports to the management board. Monitor key financial metrics, with a particular focus on working capital, profitability, margins, and liquidity. Proactively identify financial risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Analyze sales performance, cost structure, and business profitability to support strategic decision-making. Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of financial reporting. Work closely with leadership to support business planning and financial decision-making. Continuously improve financial processes, reporting standards, and internal controls. Working Conditions Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Flexible working hours. 20 paid days off annually.
